description: This file defines an enumeration named 'Zoom' that specifies various zoom factors for a PDF preview control in the PdfSharp.Forms namespace. It includes configurable zoom levels, as well as special fitting options like 'BestFit', 'FullPage', and 'OriginalSize'.

classes.name: Zoom
classes.description: An enumeration that specifies predefined zoom levels for a PDF viewer preview control.
